abilities.name: Winter's Hide
abilities.description: You can activate this ability when resisting cold, ice or a chill-based effect and get a boon to the roll. You also ignore the first point of damage from cold each round.

abilities.name: Icebreaker
abilities.description: Your blows shatter frozen things. When you hit an enemy that is frozen, chilled or made of ice, you deal an extra D6 damage.
